mechanism_fidelity.rationale: The mapping preserves incomplete history, cross-checking independent dated records, supported chronological custody links, and bounded reconstruction with explicit gaps. Document identity errors, copied or forged records, and undocumented transfers retain the relevant source limits.

target_fidelity.rationale: Establishing which tender documents the preferred bidder possessed before publication provides an explicitly bounded contribution to the steering inquiry: evidence of advance access. The mapping does not claim that access establishes steering, motive, or clause authorship.

operational_coherence.rationale: The stipulated authenticated records establish whole-document identities and some prepublication transfers. Cross-checking their dates and custodians can therefore warrant bounded possession histories and advance-access findings while leaving missing intervals unresolved.

validity.rationale: All three criteria pass. The provenance mechanism supports a limited evidentiary contribution to the retained steering question without treating document possession as proof of influence over the award.

uncertainty: Missing intervals leave portions of document custody and transmission unresolved.
Advance access alone does not establish whether the award was steered or whether the bidder supplied or influenced particular clauses.
